name: Rendezvous
source:
Bar "Rendezvous" quietly waits for visitors in the corner of the city. People from different circles spend time here. Tonight romance awaits you...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“Rendezvous”酒吧静静等待来客，坐落于城市一隅。来自不同圈子的人在此消磨时光。今夜，浪漫正等着你……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
